questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence with inversion for emphasis.

A) Never before have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
B) So beautiful was the sunset that I couldn't take my eyes off it.
C) I have never seen such a beautiful sunset.
D) The sunset was so beautiful that I couldn't take my eyes off it.
options: Never before have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
So beautiful was the sunset that I couldn't take my eyes off it.
I have never seen such a beautiful sunset.
The sunset was so beautiful that I couldn't take my eyes off it.
questions.answer: So beautiful was the sunset that I couldn't take my eyes off it.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the location of the meeting?

A) It was in the conference room that we decided to postpone the meeting.
B) The meeting was in the conference room that we decided to postpone.
C) We decided to postpone the meeting was in the conference room.
D) The conference room was where we decided to postpone the meeting.
options: It was in the conference room that we decided to postpone the meeting.
The meeting was in the conference room that we decided to postpone.
We decided to postpone the meeting was in the conference room.
The conference room was where we decided to postpone the meeting.
questions.answer: It was in the conference room that we decided to postpone the meeting.

questions.question:

A) If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.
B) If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.
C) If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.
D) If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.
options: If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.
If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.
If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.
If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.
questions.answer: If I had known about the cancellation, I would have attended the lecture.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal suggestion?

A) I suggest that the committee members attend the meeting.
B) It is suggested that the committee members attend the meeting.
C) I recommend that the committee members attend the meeting.
D) We propose that the committee members attend the meeting.
options: I suggest that the committee members attend the meeting.
It is suggested that the committee members attend the meeting.
I recommend that the committee members attend the meeting.
We propose that the committee members attend the meeting.
questions.answer: It is suggested that the committee members attend the meeting.

questions.question:

A) All students except Sarah have submitted their assignments.
B) All students have submitted their assignments except Sarah.
C) All students have submitted their assignments except Sarah.
D) All students except Sarah have submitted their assignments.
options: All students except Sarah have submitted their assignments.
All students have submitted their assignments except Sarah.
All students have submitted their assignments except Sarah.
All students except Sarah have submitted their assignments.
questions.answer: All students except Sarah have submitted their assignments.
